title: Randomness & Noise — every example, by concept
note: Comprehensive map of all randomness/noise artifacts, grouped by the problem each solves. Duplicates (multiple artifacts for the same concept) are kept on purpose so you can pick the one you want. Each concept gets a small -> medium -> large -> applied ladder. Generated by tools/build_randomness_concept_map.py.

Uniform random / RNG.truth: Flat chance — every outcome equally likely; the rectangle of pure ignorance before structure arrives.

Coin / dice / discrete chance.truth: Discrete chance — a finite set of faces, each with its slice of certainty.

Random walk.truth: A path with no plan — each step a fresh coin, the whole a drunkard's signature.

Probability distribution.truth: Not all outcomes are equal — a distribution is the shape chance prefers.

Gaussian / normal.truth: The bell is what many small accidents add up to — the central-limit attractor.

Custom / rejection sampling.truth: Throw darts, keep the ones under the curve — sample any shape by refusing the rest.

Monte Carlo.truth: Estimate the unknowable by throwing enough random darts at it.

Perlin noise.truth: Smooth, coherent randomness — noise with neighbours, the texture of the natural world.

Simplex / Worley / value noise.truth: Other ways to make coherent noise — lattices, cells, and gradients beyond Perlin.

Noise fields & textures.truth: Noise becomes a field — every point in space assigned a value that flows.

Noise terrain / landscapes.truth: Let noise be height — and randomness becomes landscape.

Blue noise / sampling.truth: Random but evenly spaced — chance without clumping, the eye's preferred scatter.

Markov chains.truth: The next state remembers only the last — memoryless chains that still make patterns.

Seeds / PRNG vs TRNG.truth: Pseudo-randomness is deterministic in disguise — same seed, same 'chance' every time.

Entropy.truth: Randomness measured — how many bits of surprise a source actually carries.

Random transformations.truth: Perturb the regular — rotation, position, decay drawn from chance.

10 PRINT / generative grid.truth: One line of chance per cell builds a maze — the smallest generative grammar.

Random art / scatter.truth: Chance as a brush — Pollock's drips, Molnar's disorder, the aesthetics of the unplanned.

Particle randomness.truth: Give a thousand particles their own dice — emergent texture from individual chance.
